description: Trustpilot Reviews API: List company reviews. Public reviews of a company with filters. `meta.complete` is false when the source caps the reviews reachable for a filter combination. Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

limit.description: Reviews per page (max 20, one page of the source)

with_reply.description: Only reviews with a company reply

name: trustpilot_company_reviews
title: List company reviews
